latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of hk-weather skill providing real-time Hong Kong weather data from the official Hong Kong Observatory open data API.
- Supports current weather, weather warnings (typhoon, rainstorm, thunderstorm), and 9-day forecasts.
- Output available in Traditional Chinese or English based on user query language.
- No dependencies or API keys required; safe, read-only API usage.
- Designed for concise, factual responses and reliable error handling if API fails.
